scheme_name: Scholarship Scheme for Worker's Children- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Scholarship Scheme for Worker’s Children is an initiative launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

This scheme was introduced to provide financial assistance to the children of registered workers in the state of Haryana. 

The scheme aims to promote education among the children of workers by offering scholarships. 

It was officially launched on 1st April 2018. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to encourage the education of children from economically weaker sections of society. 

The scheme specifically targets children whose parents are registered as workers under the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

The scholarship is intended to alleviate the financial burden on families and ensure that children have access to quality education. 

The scheme has set measurable targets to increase the enrollment of children in schools and higher education institutions. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board aims to provide scholarships to at least 10,000 children annually under this scheme. 

The financial assistance provided under the scheme is structured based on the level of education. 

For students in primary education, the scholarship amount is ₹1,000 per annum. 

For students in secondary education, the scholarship amount is ₹2,000 per annum. 

For students pursuing higher secondary education, the scholarship amount is ₹3,000 per annum. 

For those enrolled in professional courses, the scholarship amount can go up to ₹5,000 per annum. 

The eligibility criteria for the scholarship are clearly defined. 

Applicants must be children of registered workers under the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 5 years for primary education. 

There is no maximum age limit specified for higher education. 

The income criteria stipulate that the family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹2 lakh per annum. 

The educational requirements vary based on the level of scholarship being applied for. 

For primary education, applicants must be enrolled in a recognized school. 

For secondary and higher secondary education, applicants must be enrolled in recognized institutions. 

For professional courses, applicants must be enrolled in institutions that are recognized by the relevant authorities. 

The application process is straightforward and designed to be user-friendly. 

Applicants must fill out the scholarship application form available on the Haryana Labour Welfare Board's official website. 

The application form requires personal details such as the applicant's name, age, and educational institution. 

Applicants must also provide details about their parents' registration with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

Required documents include a copy of the worker's registration certificate. 

A copy of the applicant's birth certificate is also necessary. 

Additionally, applicants must submit proof of income, such as an income certificate issued by a competent authority. 

Proof of enrollment in the educational institution is also required. 

Once the application is completed, it must be submitted to the nearest Labour Welfare Office. 

The application can also be submitted online through the official website of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

The timeline for application submission typically opens at the beginning of the academic year. 

The deadline for submitting applications is usually set for 30 days from the start of the academic year. 

Disbursement of the scholarship amount is done directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The scholarship amount is usually disbursed within 2 months of the application deadline. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Haryana. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at their office. 

The contact number for the Haryana Labour Welfare Board is 0172-2702000. 

The official website for the Haryana Labour Welfare Board is www.haryanalabour.gov.in. 

The scheme has seen a positive response since its inception. 

In the first year alone, over 8,000 applications were received. 

The board aims to enhance awareness about the scheme to increase participation. 

Workshops and seminars are conducted to inform workers about the benefits available to them. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve the socio-economic conditions of workers in Haryana. 

The Haryana government has allocated a budget of ₹10 crore for the implementation of this scheme for the financial year 2023-2024. 

The scheme is expected to significantly reduce dropout rates among children of workers. 

Monitoring and evaluation of the scheme are conducted regularly to assess its impact. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is committed to ensuring that no child of a registered worker is deprived of education due to financial constraints. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to social welfare and education for all. 

By providing financial assistance, the scheme aims to empower families and promote a culture of education. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continues to work towards enhancing the reach and effectiveness of the scholarship scheme. 

The board is also exploring partnerships with educational institutions to provide additional support to beneficiaries. 

Overall, the Scholarship Scheme for Worker’s Children is a vital initiative aimed at fostering educational opportunities for the children of workers in Haryana. 

It serves as a model for similar initiatives across other states in India. 

The scheme not only supports education but also contributes to the overall development of society by investing in the future generation. 

Through this scheme, the Haryana government aims to create a more educated workforce that can contribute to the state's economy. 

The long-term vision of the scheme is to break the cycle of poverty through education. 

This initiative is a step towards achieving the Sustainable Development Goals related to quality education and reduced inequalities. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board remains dedicated to the continuous improvement of this scholarship scheme. 

The board encourages all eligible families to take advantage of this opportunity for their children's education. 

In conclusion, the Scholarship Scheme for Worker’s Children is a comprehensive program that addresses the educational needs of the children of registered workers in Haryana. 

It provides essential financial support and promotes educational attainment among one of the most vulnerable sections of society.
